title: A ticket, start to finish
label: A support ticket's life drawn as three numbered steps on a rail. A token labelled Ticket 4821 travels from step to step: received shows the customer's subject line, triaged shows its tags, billing, priority two and the assigned agent, and the last step, resolved, lands the result: resolved in 42 minutes, rated five out of five by the customer.
heading:
From first message
to five stars.
sub: Every ticket is read, routed to the right person and closed with the customer's own rating.

steps.title: Received
steps.detail: By email, chat or form, in one queue.

steps.title: Triaged
steps.detail: Tagged, prioritised and sent to the right person.

steps.title: Resolved
steps.detail: Refund issued and the customer told why.
